Moodle MCP for ChatGPT

Connect teachers and authorized course managers to Moodle through their own ChatGPT accounts, using the MCP protocol and the permissions already defined for their courses.

The block provides a course-level connection panel and integrates with local_mcp. Students cannot view the block, authorize a connection through it, discover its MCP tools or execute them, even if a legacy configuration once allowed a broader audience.

Course-level capabilities
  • Individual ChatGPT connections using each educator's Moodle account.
  • Teacher-focused access to authorized course information and tools.
  • Access restricted by block/mcp:teach and block/mcp:use.
  • Optional, allowlisted course WRITE tools, disabled by default.
Teaching staff access
Teachers, editing teachers and authorized managers can connect with their own Moodle credentials. The block is not visible or available to students.
Course-scoped tools
MCP tools operate in authorized course contexts. Moodle checks capabilities and the current course block when tools are discovered and when each operation is executed.
Controlled writing
Approved course management actions can be enabled for eligible teaching staff with block/mcp:write. Read-only access is the default, and supported changes require confirmation.
Course integrations without shared credentials

Connecting an AI client with one shared account would bypass the distinction between educators and learners. Moodle MCP for ChatGPT checks each user's Moodle capabilities, course visibility and available block configuration instead. A manager may have authorized access without being enrolled as a course participant.

Legacy audience=all settings do not enable student access. The 1.0.1 beta integrates with local_mcp, including its teacher OAuth authorization extension; custom MCP connections must also be supported by the educator's ChatGPT account or workspace.
